events.title: Mindy Seu: A Sexual History of the Internet
events.description: Designer and researcher Mindy Seu discusses the evolution of digital subcultures, examining the relationship between internet history, sexuality, and technological development. This session is hosted by the Institute of Modern Art and is geared toward intellectually engaged audiences interested in internet culture.

events.title: Olivera Simić — Writing Trauma
events.description: A writing workshop led by Olivera Simić focusing on the complexities of transcribing personal or collective trauma into narrative form. Held at the beloved local Avid Reader bookstore, this session is for writers looking to deepen their craft in a supportive, thoughtful environment.

events.title: Brisbane Makerspace — Maker Mondays
events.description: An open social evening for people interested in DIY projects, electronics, and making things. A recurring community event where enthusiasts gather to share knowledge, work on prototypes, and socialize with like-minded creators.

events.title: HSBNE (Hackerspace Brisbane) — Open Night
events.description: The Hackerspace Brisbane facility opens its doors for an informal tour and community meet-and-greet. Expect to meet people working on hardware, robotics, and creative engineering projects in a collaborative, hands-on workshop environment.

events.title: Sonder Brisbane — Language Exchange Meetup
events.description: A relaxed, recurring community meetup for people looking to practice foreign languages and meet locals from diverse cultural backgrounds. The Burrow provides an intimate, low-key setting perfect for natural conversation between strangers.

events.title: Books@Stones — In-Conversation with Jane Smith & Jo Skinner
events.description: A local community book event featuring authors Jane Smith and Jo Skinner in a conversational panel. This is an intimate, intellectual setting aimed at local literature lovers, allowing for direct interaction with the authors.

events.title: Books@Stones — Screen Wise (Madonna King)
events.description: Journalist Madonna King discusses her book 'Screen Wise', exploring the intersection of technology and human behavior in adolescents. The event provides a space for parents and interested community members to discuss modern psychological and technological challenges.
